notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v2.0: Major gameplay update
notes.content:
Today we're happy to bring you a big update to Hatsune Miku VR:

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]- Gameplay Update[/b]
Notes will now come closer to you, letting you pick them up in front of you instead of having to extend your arms to the sides, to better accommodate different players and hardware.

[b]- 8 Speakers[/b]
Four new speakers have been added as sources of notes, making for more variation. And in hard modes the speakers start to move...

[b]- Sound Effect ON/OFF option[/b]
Due to popular demand, there is now an option letting you turn off the sound when you pick up or miss a note.

[b]- Updated Menu[/b]
Improved menu legibility by using a larger font.

Due to these changes, the leaderboards have also been reset.

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v1.1: trading cards, new songs DLC and fixes
notes.content:
Welcome again Hatsune Miku fans.

We are happy to announce the release of the first new songs DLC for Hatsune Miku VR, adding 5 new songs to the game
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32198783/52fcef47878ed58300fca03e5811bbab2881a64e.png[/img]

[h1]Hatsune Miku VR - 5 songs pack 1[/h1]
store.steampowered.com/app/929480

Moreover, version 1.1 updates the game as follow:
- In hard mode, you can [b]break the iron balls[/b] with the sticks while in fever mode.
- Fix to the sound volume control

Finally, [b]Trading cards[/b] have now been added to the game, with gorgeous backgrounds for full collections!
